label: Candidate: Senior DevOps Specialist
jd: DevOps Engineer: manage AWS infrastructure with Terraform, run CI/CD pipelines, take part in the on-call rotation, and improve system reliability. 4+ years of experience.
resume:
Karan Malhotra | karan.m@example.com | +91 99876 54321
Senior DevOps Engineer, 7 years
- Architected a multi-region AWS platform with 99.99% uptime using Terraform and Kubernetes
- Owned the on-call rotation and reduced incident response time by 60%
- Built CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins and GitHub Actions for 30 services
- Led a team of 6 engineers
Skills: AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Python, Linux
transcript:
Interviewer: Welcome, Karan. Tell me about the multi-region platform you architected.
Candidate: It was a big, exciting project and honestly the team loved it. We ran the application in two regions so customers always had a fast experience and the business stayed confident. I presented the roadmap to leadership every month and they were always impressed.
Interviewer: How did Terraform manage state across those regions?
Candidate: Terraform keeps the state inside the .tf files themselves, so whoever pulls the repo has the latest state. We never really needed anything beyond that.
Interviewer: What does a load balancer health check do?
Candidate: I believe it checks the CPU on the servers and removes the busy ones. I did not set those up myself, the infrastructure team handled the details.
Interviewer: Your resume says you owned the on-call rotation. What happened in your last major incident?
Candidate: Mostly the senior engineers handled incidents. I watched the dashboards and let them know when something looked red. I did not run any incident myself, but I learned a lot from watching.
Interviewer: Tell me about working with your team.
Candidate: I really care about people. When two engineers disagreed I sat them down over coffee, listened to both sides, and they found a middle ground. I run a friendly retro every sprint and the feedback has always been positive.
Interviewer: And the team of six you led?
Candidate: I mentored a group of six on the team and checked in with each of them weekly, so I'd say I led them in spirit.
